content.title: Progressive Framing | Environment to Eye Reaction
content.summary: Tighten the framing step by step from the large environment to the character, one local discovery, a personal device, and finally a close-up eye reaction, creating a purely visual evidence funnel.

quick_start.input_format: Grand environment + stable character/pair + ground or local discovery + character’s personal device + final close-up reaction
quick_start.recommended_input: The orbital maintenance module first shows the grand Earth background, with two engineers maintaining stable positions; the camera tightens to the metal pads on the ground, then to one engineer’s wrist detector, and finally stops on the restrained exchange of glances between the two.
required_anchors: Evidence transitions from environment to local detail to device
Finally, close with a close-up reaction
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Short mysteries or investigations that progressively tighten the framing from a monumental environment to the subjects, a local discovery, a subject-owned device, and a final close-up reaction.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Begin with monumental environment scale and a tiny stable subject pair. Contract framing in discrete evidence steps—paired medium, full-body investigation, object inspection, subject-owned mechanism insert and eye-level reaction—so every scale change answers one question and raises a more personal one. Preserve route, axis and identity, keep performance restrained, and stop at the facial endpoint instead of adding another action branch.

invariants.rule: Establish world scale, route and the stable subject group in an extreme or very wide opening.
invariants.purpose: Gives later close evidence a measurable spatial and emotional baseline.
invariants.ablation_failure: Opening close removes the scale contrast and makes later inserts feel arbitrary.

invariants.rule: Contract framing through ordered information layers rather than random beauty shots.
invariants.purpose: Turns camera scale into an evidence funnel.
invariants.ablation_failure: Repeated similar coverage reveals no new question and produces a flat montage.

invariants.rule: Move the evidence from the shared environment to a local object and then to a mechanism owned by the lead subject.
invariants.purpose: Raises personal stakes without requiring a copied threat or effect.
invariants.ablation_failure: Unrelated props do not create an inward causal progression.

invariants.rule: Preserve the same route axis, subject identities and wardrobe or material markers across every scale change.
invariants.purpose: Lets the audience read all shots as one continuous investigation.
invariants.ablation_failure: Continuity drift makes the scale ladder look like disconnected footage.

invariants.rule: End on one restrained face or sensor response immediately after the closest mechanism proof.
invariants.purpose: Converts physical evidence into a readable human or system endpoint.
invariants.ablation_failure: A new action after the reaction restarts the sequence and weakens the funnel closure.

slots.name: lead_subject_group
slots.constraint: One stable person, pair or machine group whose identity remains continuous.

slots.name: monumental_setting
slots.constraint: A setting with a readable route and strong wide-scale geography.

slots.name: local_discovery
slots.constraint: One small external object or state that justifies stopping.

slots.name: owned_mechanism
slots.constraint: One tool, garment mechanism or device physically associated with the lead subject.

slots.name: scale_ladder
slots.constraint: A deliberate wide-to-close information order in which each scale reveals new evidence.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: Restrained testing and recognition rather than exaggerated reaction.

slots.name: final_response
slots.constraint: One face, lens or status response that closes the sequence.

anti_copy_exclusions: two wuxia women in white and green robes
silver sword, pebble test and the source Mandarin dialogue
the unverified four-step audio-before-action rule and exact source shot boundaries

instantiations.concept: Two orbital engineers cross a vast repair bay, stop at a washer pulled toward a sealed bulkhead, inspect a wrist seal tester carrying the same pulse and end on one engineer listening toward the door.
instantiations.prompt_seed: Orbital suspense told by a world-to-pair-to-object-to-device-to-eyes evidence funnel.

instantiations.concept: A ranger pair crosses a giant wind farm, kneels at a frost-covered feather, checks the same crystalline growth on a handheld vane and ends on a controlled gaze toward one silent turbine.
instantiations.prompt_seed: Wind-farm mystery using ordered scale contraction and restrained verification.

instantiations.concept: Two conservators enter a monumental archive, find one curled paper fiber, inspect the same curl inside a book clasp and finish on a magnified eye reaction under stable warm light.
instantiations.prompt_seed: Archive investigation that narrows from hall scale to material evidence and a final face.

failure_modes.failure: Opening close removes the scale contrast and makes later inserts feel arbitrary.
failure_modes.repair: Begin with a route-readable monumental wide and stable subject group.

failure_modes.failure: Repeated similar coverage reveals no new question and produces a flat montage.
failure_modes.repair: Assign one new evidence job to every scale contraction.

failure_modes.failure: Unrelated props do not create an inward causal progression.
failure_modes.repair: Link the external discovery and subject-owned mechanism through one visible state.

failure_modes.failure: Continuity drift makes the scale ladder look like disconnected footage.
failure_modes.repair: Lock route axis, identity and material markers across all shots.

failure_modes.failure: A new action after the reaction restarts the sequence and weakens the funnel closure.
failure_modes.repair: Hold the final face or sensor response as the endpoint.
